problem: The exact-head Defold runtime workflow can prove that a bundle renders, but it has no dependency-free way to inject real browser keyboard/touch events and assert collection-proxy input routing or modal consumption for BB-003.

decision.rationale: Add a standard-library Chromium DevTools probe to the existing exact-head runtime-evidence workflow, but execute it only when the scoped input-proxy proof resource exists. This keeps ordinary bootstrap heads valid while making the future BB-003 head fail on routing/consumption regressions.

research.candidate_pool_exception: Shipped-product reference research is not applicable to a CI/governance support change; the behavior under test is defined by browser and Defold technical contracts.
research.reference_exception: No player-facing design is selected or evaluated in this support PR.

anti_pattern.observation: Assuming proxy-world input propagation without exercising the proxy owner's focus path would leave the BB-003 risk unproven.
anti_pattern.lesson: The runtime gate must inject actual browser input and observe delivery/consumption across the engine-managed focus stacks.

official_docs.verified_constraint: A collection proxy loads a separate game world, and the game object containing the proxy must participate in input focus for input to propagate into that world.
Input focus is stack ordered; an on_input callback may return true to consume an action and stop further propagation.
Chromium DevTools exposes dispatchKeyEvent and dispatchTouchEvent for deterministic browser input injection.

alternatives.reason: Reuses the existing exact-head HTML5 server/browser environment, adds no package dependency, and stays inert until a scoped runtime proof resource is present.
Manual keyboard/touch checks would not be repeatable at an exact PR head and would not reliably catch focus-stack regressions.
Selenium/Playwright/Puppeteer would add dependency and provenance surface when Chromium CDP can be driven with the Python standard library already present on the runner.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The existing development/release HTML5 build and screenshot artifact path remains intact.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: .github/workflows/defold-runtime-evidence.yml retains both pinned bundle commands, Chromium screenshot capture and artifact upload.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: A BB-003 input-proxy resource causes the exact-head workflow to execute the browser input smoke and fail if that script fails.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: The workflow gates tools/defold/chromium_input_proxy_smoke.py behind existence of app/input_probe.collectionproxy and runs it under set -euo pipefail.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Heads without the BB-003 proof resource remain valid and record the smoke as not applicable.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: The workflow writes a machine-readable not_applicable input-proxy-smoke.json when app/input_probe.collectionproxy is absent.

automated: Pull-request exact-head Defold runtime workflow exercises the changed workflow because tools/defold/chromium_input_proxy_smoke.py is in its path filter.
Trusted-base PR evidence and trust-boundary validators classify the workflow change as process/governance work with this same-PR manifest.
verification.runtime_errors: No gameplay/runtime behavior is changed by this support PR; exact-head CI must remain green before merge.

governance.trust_boundary_change: Extends only the non-authoritative Defold runtime-evidence workflow with an optional exact-head browser-input probe. It does not modify the trusted PR evidence workflow, trusted-base policy scripts, ruleset requirements, permissions, checkout credentials, or merge authority.
governance.bypass_analysis: The probe is optional only when its scoped marker resource is absent. A BB-003 runtime PR that adds app/input_probe.collectionproxy triggers the existing app/** path and the probe branch. Mixing a workflow edit with high-risk app/game.project changes is independently rejected by trusted-base classification, so a candidate cannot weaken this hook inside the same technical BB-003 PR without failing policy.
governance.rollback: Revert .github/workflows/defold-runtime-evidence.yml and remove tools/defold/chromium_input_proxy_smoke.py; the previous build/screenshot evidence path and trusted PR evidence gate remain available and unchanged.

known_limitations: This support PR does not itself contain the input-proxy test scene, so the probe records not_applicable until BB-003 adds the scoped resource.
